Molecules 2025

Anticonvulsant Effects of Synthetic N-(3-Methoxybenzyl)oleamide and N-(3-Methoxybenzyl)linoleamide Macamides: An In Silico and In Vivo Study

This study evaluates the anticonvulsant properties of novel synthetic macamides through computational and animal model analyses, indicating their potential therapeutic applications.

A Theoretical Study on the Efficacy and Mechanism of Combined YAP-1 and PARP-1 Inhibitors in the Treatment of Glioblastoma Multiforme Using Peruvian Maca Lepidium meyenii

This theoretical research explores the combined use of YAP-1 and PARP-1 inhibitors derived from Peruvian Maca in treating glioblastoma multiforme, suggesting enhanced therapeutic efficacy.
